description: Query the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine capture index (CDX Server API).

novel_features.name: Content-change detection via digest-diff
novel_features.description: Collapse a URL's Wayback Machine capture history by content digest to report exactly when the page content changed — the first capture is the baseline (first-seen) and each later digest flip is a change event. Surfaces content-change cadence the Wayback web UI and URL-listing tools do not.
